notes: The projection carries the selected readings of WLC.PRO.21.29.v002 and v003 (r01), which the ASV's printed *he establisheth his ways* matches; no new textual decision was made (rule 9).
The ASV's textual note *Another reading is, he considereth his way* was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
*as for* is `added` and headed on *as*: the fronted יָשָׁר carries no marker and no preposition (rule 16); בְּ is `unrepresented` because the ASV writes a bare direct object (rule 40).
